description: Create a VietQR (NAPAS 247) bank-transfer QR payload. Returns the EMVCo string, CRC and optionally a PNG image. Bank accepts BIN (970436), code (VCB) or name (Vietcombank). Amount is integer VND; note is sanitized (no diacritics, max 25 chars).

amount.description: Amount in VND (integer). Omit for a static QR.

bank.description: Bank BIN, code or name, e.g. "VCB", "970436", "Vietcombank"

image.description: Also return a PNG image (base64). Default false.

name: vietqr_build
title: Build VietQR
